subject.title: Refactor guarded fetch to isolate one manual-redirect network hop

question: Should the maintainer sponsor the linked local-only extraction as the desired internal seam for future transport work?
rationale: The issue intentionally narrows an earlier proposal after maintainer-oriented feedback, but accepting a new internal seam inside the SSRF boundary is an ownership and architecture decision that cannot be inferred safely from the issue alone.

options.title: Review the narrow extraction
options.body: Keep the existing security loop authoritative and evaluate the linked PR as the bounded internal refactor described here.

options.title: Decline the new seam
options.body: Close or redirect the linked PR if the existing inline transport call is preferred until a broader approved connection-owner design exists.

recommendation.title: Review the narrow extraction
recommendation.body: Keep the existing security loop authoritative and evaluate the linked PR as the bounded internal refactor described here.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidenced participant carrying both the original and narrowed implementation context; a current-main networking owner could not be established from available read-only evidence.
